items.headline: Scheffler’s Memorial frustration
items.text: Scottie Scheffler shot 1-over 73 with a double bogey on the 16th after hooking his tee shot into the water, snapping at caddie Ted Scott and sitting six shots back at the Memorial Tournament.

items.headline: McIlroy evaluates new driver
items.text: Rory McIlroy assessed his driving quality on Thursday at the Memorial after making a change to his setup ahead of the event.
